Since the "Highest Reward" arm has already been sampled once and yielded a negative result (-0.3), and the other two arms have not been sampled at all, it is statistically optimal to explore the remaining arms to identify their distributions before committing to one. I will start by testing the "Intermediate Reward" arm.
